name: CVE-Bench
description: CVE-Bench is a real-world cybersecurity benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of LLM agents to autonomously exploit critical-severity web application vulnerabilities in realistic sandboxed environments.
reputation: A new cybersecurity benchmark for agentic exploitation in realistic sandboxed web environments, with growing interest but limited community adoption so far.
notes: Focuses on real-world web application vulnerabilities with a sandbox framework to mimic real conditions and evaluate exploit success.
